headline: Quality and safety assessment — the plan to replace subjective judgement with evidence-backed PASS/WARN/FAIL grades and map internal controls to the CASAN H1–H7 framework — is the only item in this area, and the code reviewed did not confirm it either way.
what_is_there: The code that was examined includes security policy rules that block or deny certain actions, and a separate mechanism that scores and routes work to models based on fit. Neither of these is the structured PASS/WARN/FAIL grading with supporting evidence, nor the CASAN control mapping, that the ticket describes.
what_is_unclear: Whether any of the intended grading and control-mapping work exists elsewhere in the product could not be established, because only a keyword-selected slice of the codebase was read. The ticket is also still open in the tracker, so its absence here is consistent with not having started.
suggested_action: Ask the owning engineer whether any evidence-based quality grading or CASAN control mapping exists yet, and if not, confirm the ticket is genuinely unstarted rather than partly built somewhere unexamined.
